custom_codes_not_applicable.note: CUSTOM_EXCLUSION/CUSTOM_REQUIREMENT/CUSTOM_PREFERENCE are open-ended per-household labels (see custom_dietary_rules), not a fixed taxonomy code with one meaning -- there is no single 'does recipe X meet CUSTOM_EXCLUSION' answer to precompute. They are resolved at query time against a specific rule's canonical_ingredient_id, which is engine-runtime logic, not a per-recipe classification row.
